generalAbilities.name: Wavesense (Imprecise) 60 feet
generalAbilities.description:
See rules...

This sense allows a monster to feel vibrations caused by movement through a liquid. It's an imprecise sense with a limited range (listed in the ability). Wavesense functions only if monster and the subject are in the same body of liquid, and only if the subject is moving through the liquid.

defensiveAbilities.name: Countered by Earth
defensiveAbilities.description: If the sea dragon is targeted with an earth spell or Petrify, they lose Liquefy until the end of their next turn.

defensiveAbilities.name: Fed by Metal
defensiveAbilities.description:
When a sea dragon is struck by a weapon made primarily of metal or affected by a spell that uses metal, many of the dragon's scales transform to mimic the metal. This grants the dragon a +1 item bonus to AC until the start of their next turn.

Effect: Fed by Metal

defensiveAbilities.name: Frightful Presence
defensiveAbilities.description:
90 feet. DC 24 Will Saving Throw

See rules...

A creature that first enters the area must attempt a Will save.

Regardless of the result of the saving throw, the creature is temporarily immune to this monster's Frightful Presence for 1 minute.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected by the presence.

Success The creature is Frightened 1.

Failure The creature is Frightened 2.

Critical Failure The creature is Frightened 4.

defensiveAbilities.name: Liquefy
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The dragon is targeted by a Strike or spell that could deal fire or physical damage to them

Effect The dragon liquefies, turning entirely to water while maintaining their shape, for a split second. Against the triggering effect, they gain resistance 15 to fire and to all physical damage.

offensiveAbilities.name: Breath Weapon
offensiveAbilities.description:
The dragon shoots a ball of water that deals 9d6 Bludgeoning Damage damage in a 20ft Burst within 40 feet (Basic DC 26 Reflex Saving Throw save). All non-magical fire in the radius is extinguished.

The dragon can't use Breath Weapon again for 1d4 rounds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Coiling Frenzy
offensiveAbilities.description: The dragon makes one claw Strike and one tail Strike in either order, each against the same target. If either Strike hits, the dragon automatically Grabs the target.

offensiveAbilities.name: Constrict
offensiveAbilities.description:
(2d8+6) Bludgeoning Damage, Basic DC 26 Fortitude Saving Throw

See rules...

The monster deals the listed amount of damage to any number of creatures Grabbed or Restrained by it. Each of those creatures can attempt a basic Fortitude save with the listed DC.

offensiveAbilities.name: Draconic Momentum
offensiveAbilities.description: The dragon recharges their Breath Weapon whenever they score a critical hit with a Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Hyponatremia
offensiveAbilities.description: A living creature that takes damage from the sea dragon's jaws Strike must succeed at a DC 26 Fortitude Saving Throw save or become Sickened 1 as a surge of excess water floods its body.

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.

lv1spells.name: Create Water (At Will)
lv1spells.description: As you cup your hands, water begins to flow forth from them. You create 2 gallons of water. If no one drinks it, it evaporates after 1 day.

lv2spells.name: Endure Elements (Self Only)
lv2spells.duration: until the next time you make your daily preparations
lv2spells.description:
You shield the target against dangerous temperatures. Choose severe cold or heat. The target is protected from the temperature you chose (but not extreme cold or heat).

Heightened (3rd) The target is protected from severe cold and heat.

Heightened (5th) The target is protected from severe cold, severe heat, extreme cold, and extreme heat.

lv2spells.name: Water Walk (Constant)
lv2spells.description:
The target can walk on the surface of water and other liquids without falling through. It can go underwater if it wishes, but in that case it must Swim normally. This spell doesn't grant the ability to breathe underwater.

Heightened (4th) The spell's range increases to 30 feet, the duration increases to 1 hour, and you can target up to 10 creatures.
